card.title: IPad Pro 9.7 Not Powering on, 2a or Higher Power Draw before Prompt to Boot

source.title: IPad Pro 9.7 Not Powering on, 2a or Higher Power Draw before Prompt to Boot

claims.statement: An iPad Pro 9.7 drawing current before power-on has a short, most often on PP_VCC_MAIN, otherwise PP_BATT_VCC, PPSTROBE_LX or PPVCC_HIGH.
With a VCC_MAIN short, U8500 also gets hot; don't assume it is the cause—look for other hot spots.
A healthy VCC_MAIN reads about 0.400–0.500 in diode mode after the short is removed.

procedure: Inspect for blown parts and liquid.
Inject 4 V / 2 A; locate the hot part (not just U8500).
Remove shorted decoupling cap or replace shorted chip; clean corrosion under ICs.
card.caveats: Community-written Repair Wiki page, paraphrased; check the linked page (and its images) before acting on a reading.
